notes: Cutting Optimiser: Typing a profile code now brings in its colours and description exactly as they are in Inventory today, so a colour you have changed there comes through.
Fewer Buttons: The Cutting Optimiser shows Reset, Save and Print Cutting List. Saved Lists, Saw Settings and Book Into Stock are under More.
Reset: A new Reset button clears the cutting list on screen so you can start again. Your saved lists are kept.
